instructions:
Enforced editing guard: edit only src/alpha.ts, src/inscope/ using the editing tool actually present in your tool schema. A mentioned tool is not necessarily registered. Source-writing shell commands and helper files are prohibited. Read the intended range with read_files immediately before editing. Existing files require a unique exact old_text/new_text replacement (at most 2000 characters each), or a verified insert_line; whole-file rewrites are prohibited. Do not reconstruct backslashes from escaped output. Two consecutive failed native edits stop this attempt. Select run_commands.commands from its exact enum; do not invent commands. Three invalid tool requests stop this attempt. Approved command choices (prefer npm.cmd/npx.cmd on Windows):
npm run check
npm.cmd run check
npm run lint
npm.cmd run lint
npm run typecheck
npm.cmd run typecheck
git diff --check
npx prettier --check src/alpha.ts
npx.cmd prettier --check src/alpha.ts
npx prettier --write src/alpha.ts
npx.cmd prettier --write src/alpha.ts
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff --numstat
git diff --name-only
git rev-parse HEAD
git diff -- src/alpha.ts
git ls-files -- src/alpha.ts
git show HEAD:src/alpha.ts
git diff -- src/inscope/
git ls-files -- src/inscope/
git show HEAD:src/inscope/
Do not wrap commands in PowerShell/cmd or redirect output.
